messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: Strange error for TitanCNA, need help!!
parts:
Hi,

The error comes up here:
logR <- getPositionOverlap(data$chr,data$position,cnData)

This line of code finds the overlap of the positions in your file chr1_c.txt with the 1kb regions in your wig files.  Can you confirm that the positions in this file do indeed overlap some of these regions?  

From this error below, it appears that none of your 43157 positions overlap with cnData

Calls: getPositionOverlap -> data.frame
